improve.title: Defensive work rate
tips: Defend the space, not just the player. Stand in the lane they want to pass into.
Make yourself big in the box when they shoot. Blocks count, even if the stats don't.
When the ball is lost, the nearest player presses and everyone else closes the passing lanes.

improve.title: On-ball involvement
tips: Move after you pass. A pass-and-move player is always an option.
Drift into the half-space between their midfield and defense. It's the hardest spot to mark.
Check away, then check back. A two-yard feint buys you the space to receive.
improve.coach: 40% overall, same lately. Our next project.

improve.title: Off-ball positioning
tips: Hold the line with your partner and step up together. Don't let a dropping striker drag you out.
Your rating came in lower than your stats say, and that gap is off-ball: positioning, interceptions, blocks.
Hold your spot in the shape when the ball's on the far side. Drifting leaves the back line naked.
improve.coach: Consistent at 30%. Targeted practice will help.

strengths.title: Goal threat
strengths.coach: That's the sound of the scoreboard saying thank you. Shows up in 40% of your matches. That's a calling card.

strengths.title: Chance creation
strengths.coach: You see the field like a hawk sees a cornfield. 40% of games. Never lose it.
